The exact integral Pfaffian identity for all principal size-eight minors and explicit lower-rank witnesses prove the rank classification without characteristic restrictions; case counts sum to q^6. Finite additive-character orthogonality yields the central commutator fibers, with q^14 Fourier normalization; polynomial simplification gives the stated gap. The actual standalone verifier exhaustively matched q=2,3,4,5 rank profiles, and literal commutator linear systems at q=2; the symbolic checker reproduced all Pfaffian polynomials.

value.rationale: The complete finite-field Kirillov rank distribution is a natural refinement of Borel orbit-index theory at the first four-by-four triangular size where two independent rank-eight degeneracy expressions arise. Fourier inversion turns it into a quantitative zero-versus-highest-root commutator-fiber gap, distinguishing the zero target from every nonzero highest-root target by q^11(q^2+q-1). This links geometric stabilizer stratification and exact arithmetic commutator counting; neither part follows from a generic index or a mere computational sample.
